A variable is used to store a value in a program.
A variable is a named memory location used to store data.
Variables allow us to store and use data in a program.
A loop is used to execute a block of code repeatedly.
Loops help us repeat a task multiple times.
A loop runs a block of code again and again based on a condition.
A for loop in python is used to iterate over a sequence (such as list, tuple, set, Dictionary or String) and execute the block of code for each item
A control flow statement used to iterate over a sequence (like a list, tuple, dictionary, set, or string) or any other iterable object
A while loop in python repeadly executes a block of code as long as a specified boolean condition remains true
While Loop is used to execute a block of statements repeatedly until a given condition is satisfied. When the condition becomes false, the line immediately after the loop in the program is executed.

Control statements in Python are instructions that alter the standard sequential, top-to-bottom execution of a program. They allow your code to make decisions, repeat specific actions, or jump out of loops early
